messages:
noah.z: Hi everyone — Im Noah, just started on infra dev. Trying to get CI validation working. It needs to: 1) run a short job on GKE that writes a few rows into BigQuery dataset billing_workflows in project noah-sbx, 2) store signed AMI IDs into SSM at /infra/onboard/noah/amis in aws acct 222333444555, and 3) fetch a small secret from a customer-managed KMS key in another project. Who should I ping for minimal perms and what should I put in the ticket?
mica: welcome! :wave: For BigQuery, request a service account in your sandbox project with roles/bigquery.dataEditor scoped to that single dataset. Prefer dataset-level binding. Grant you roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA for impersonation.
cloud-ops: For GKE we use OIDC for CI runners. If CI will use OIDC, include the OIDC issuer and subject in the ticket so we can add trust. Create a k8s service account name you'll use (eg ci-billing-ksa) and namespace.
infra-bot: Use the cloud-access Onboarding template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Select 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions'. Include: GCP project, dataset, k8s ns + ksa, OIDC issuer/sub, AWS account id, SSM path, KMS resource, and expiry.
noah.z: For AWS SSM writes, is it better to give SSM:PutParameter via assume-role or attach an inline policy to my user?
mica: We prefer a cross-account assume-role in the infra account with a tight policy limited to the specific SSM path. That way you can get temporary sessions and we avoid long-lived creds. Put the intended session duration in the ticket.
security: Quick note: cross-project KMS access requires justification and manager approval. If the KMS key is in a production keyring, default onboarding window is 7 days and security will review. Mention whether the secret is plaintext or wrapped data.
cloud-ops: Sample text for the ticket you can paste: "Need onboarding perms for CI: project=noah-sbx, dataset=billing_workflows, k8s ns=ci, ksa=ci-billing-ksa, OIDC issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, OIDC subject=repo:org/repo:ref:refs/heads/main, aws acct=222333444555, ssm path=/infra/onboard/noah/amis, kms=projects/sec-proj/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/ci-key, expiry=7d. Purpose: CI acceptance tests to validate billing pipeline and store AMI ids"
noah.z: thanks — prefer 7d expiry. Filing now. If infra needs the CI runner service account instead of my personal user, Ill include that in the ticket. Appreciate the quick responses! :thumbsup:
